set.body: Implement the first end-to-end executable path: FmriDataset plus EventModel/BaselineModel plus FmriModel plus FitPlan executes through OLS against an in-memory dataset. Deliverables: adapters from HRF Mat and image DMat to scalafim.linalg.DoubleMatrix/ResponseBlock; FitPlanExecutor or equivalent; typed result carrying coefficients, residual variance, column names, voxel indices, df, engine, and summary. Acceptance: JVM and Scala.js tests build a toy model and recover known coefficients with no file IO, Spark, or Breeze in the shared execution path.
set.title: Slice 1: executable in-memory OLS fit
